title: Default consent gate — basic PII request

decision.llm_response:
Blocked under 34 CFR § 99.30(a) (default consent rule).
No § 99.31 exception applies and no consent is on file. Obtain signed, dated written consent that specifies records, purpose, and recipient.

advisor_reply: I apologize, but I cannot disclose Jane Doe's GPA. Under federal student privacy regulations (34 CFR § 99.30), student academic records can only be released with specific written consent from the student or parent. This protects the student's educational record privacy.
